notablePrerequisites: You have another nonland card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable targets if needed.
description:
Cast any spell by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Remand by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Remand's storm ability and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Remand trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target the original Remand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy generated, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Resolve the first Remand copy, returning the original Remand to your hand and causing you to draw a card.
All other copies of Remand fizzle due to having no legal target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
